question_text: Explain two ways regression-based analysis of historical visitor data could support planning at a museum.
adaptation_rationale: Retains forecasting uses with a named guide-listed mining technique.
solution: Predict daily attendance from seasonal and booking features to schedule enough staff. Predict shop revenue from expected attendance and past spending patterns to plan stock and cash requirements; predictions remain estimates under changed conditions.

marking_points.criterion: Links it to a planning decision.
